mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE position = #{position} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND position = '团队经理' AND department = #{department} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND position = '室经理' AND department = #{department} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.role_name FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.role_name = #{roleName} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleKeyword}, '%') ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT u.* FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.department = #{department} AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleKeyword}, '%') ORDER BY u.create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND real_name = #{realName} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
